titel: Armchair Anonymous: Out of Hand Lie

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst art19.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Wild tales of lies that spiraled completely out of control.
kurzfassung: Guests share unbelievable stories about childhood and college pranks, elaborate cover-ups, and falsehoods that escalated beyond imagination. From high school egging incidents to fake careers and planetarium emergencies, the hosts react with shock and amusement. The episode explores the strange motivations behind pathological lying and the chaos it creates.
stichpunkte: A high school egging prank turns disastrous when rival students hurl bricks at the car.
A teenager invents an elaborate ambush story to avoid her strict father finding out about the damaged car.
The mother of the teenager calls local news, featuring the damaged car on the evening broadcast.
A speech pathologist blames her frequent energy drink farts on a dead animal in the office.
The office gas smell escalates so drastically that the school considers facility renovations.
An advertising worker fabricates his entire resume, claiming to be Barack Obama's former social media director.
College students visit a planetarium while heavily intoxicated, leading to a massive medical emergency hoax.
One student fakes an anaphylactic shock and exposure to tropical diseases to cover up college drinking.

kapitel.titel: Introduction and the High School Brick Incident

clips.hook: When a harmless prank meets flying bricks.
clips.text: The situation escalates violently when opposing students unexpectedly throw bricks at the moving vehicle during a school rivalry week.

clips.hook: The unmistakable reaction to a toxic office odor.
clips.text: A colleague walks into the small room and immediately reacts with extreme disgust to the invisible stench lingering inside.

clips.hook: A delivery straight from the White House.
clips.text: The coworker brings in a multi-layer vanilla cake, claiming it was sent directly by the presidential administration to thank the team.
